findings.headline: Trump warned Warsh not to raise rates at September FOMC — presidential pressure collides with hot inflation into CPI Friday
findings.summary: Late last week Trump warned Kevin Warsh not to raise rates at this month's FOMC. Political pressure against a hike while eurozone inflation prints 3.3% and Brent nears $100 sets up a credibility collision: if the Fed folds, inflation expectations risk unanchoring; if it hikes over the president's objection, Fed-independence stress enters the bond wildfire. CPI Friday Sep 11 decides.

findings.headline: Iran vows response to US tanker strikes: American facilities 'exposed', US energy firms at risk
findings.summary: Following CENTCOM's destruction of 3 IRGC tankers, Iran vows revenge and states US facilities and energy firms in the region are 'exposed'. Rhetoric continues to escalate beyond proportionality language; coercion signaling now explicitly names US commercial energy targets.

findings.headline: Record $99bn yen intervention confirmed; funding likely from selling US Treasuries (~70% of reserves in USTs)
findings.summary: Japan's record yen intervention is now quantified at $99bn; MoF data inference says a portion of foreign securities holdings, including US Treasuries, were sold to fund it. First confirmed official-sector UST selling this cycle — a structural new channel feeding US bond stress while the wildfire burns. Sustained/escalated rung carried from Sep 7 scan with scale now confirmed.

findings.headline: USPS mail-in ballot whistleblower disclosure: 'rushed' implementation, alleged defiance of court orders (Blumenthal letter)
findings.summary: Whistleblower disclosure to Sen. Blumenthal alleges USPS lacks technical capability to implement the mail-in ballot EO and may have violated a court order continuing implementation. Governance/electoral domain — no macro-financial thread tagging. Recorded for epistemic completeness; leak category remains quiet on financial-stability content this cycle.

anonymous_leaks.note: No macro-financial leak findings in window (Sep 7-8). Single governance-domain leak recorded above; no thread impact.

findings.headline: Fed September hike odds whipsaw 62% -> 58.4% -> ~50% coin-flip into CPI Friday Sep 11; FOMC Sep 15-16
findings.summary: August NFP blowout sent hike odds to 62%, then intra-week repricing dragged them back to a ~50% coin flip (CME FedWatch). Odds split wide ~50-62% into CPI Friday Sep 11; FOMC Sep 15-16. Two central banks tightening into a supply shock — the decision trigger is now hours away, not weeks.

findings.headline: ECB hikes Sep 10 (25bp 'insurance' expected) with eurozone flash HICP at 3.3% (up from 2.9%); markets price more than economists
findings.source: Eurostat flash via samuelandcotrading / cryptobriefing / FX Bank Forecast preview
findings.summary: Euro area August flash HICP printed 3.3% y/y (Jul 2.9%), 3-year high territory. ECB Sep 10 decision two days away: 25bp expected as insurance, markets price more than economists, officials (Simkus, Makhlouf) signal more needed. Lands into a French-bond flashpoint and multiyear-high gas.

findings.headline: Yen rallies to Feb-18 high on wage data + GDP; BOJ Sep-18 hike bets harden; USD/JPY below 155
findings.summary: Upbeat wage data and GDP lifted BOJ hike bets; yen at strongest since February 18. USD/JPY dropped below 155. Hawkish-BOJ vs Fed-bets divergence remains the week's FX axis; synchronized-tightening window fully loaded (ECB Sep 10, FOMC Sep 15-16, BOJ Sep 18).

findings.headline: PBOC sets weaker USD/CNY fixing signalling depreciation risk as China pivots to state capital for growth
findings.summary: Weaker CNY fixings continue alongside the $54bn state recap: depreciation-risk signalling while credit demand stays weak and Beijing leans on state capital. Currency channel of the China stress knot still open.

findings.headline: CENTCOM destroyed 3 IRGC oil tankers after Iran targeted 2 US Navy warships with ballistic missiles
findings.summary: Official CENTCOM confirmation: 3 Iranian crude carriers struck after Iranian missile attacks on 2 US warships; no US personnel harmed. Tanker war institutionalized and now runs on official state-on-state strikes on energy logistics. Sustained from baseline.

findings.headline: Iran vows to EXTEND Hormuz exclusion zone; new restricted zone + passage-route maps still 'coming days'; CENTCOM denies Iran's claimed strike on US vessel
findings.source: The Independent (live) / CNA-Reuters / Al Jazeera explainer
findings.summary: Tehran vows to widen the exclusion zone after the tanker strikes; SNSC says the new restricted zone and Hormuz passage-route maps will be announced 'in the coming days' — still pending implementation, now with maps 'approved soon'. Disputed strike claim on a US military vessel (CENTCOM denial) keeps the crewed-vessel threshold live. War band unchanged but pressure rising.

findings.headline: Iran restricting Gulf shipping as active posture; US energy firms named at risk
findings.summary: Beyond rhetoric: Iran is actively restricting Gulf shipping while naming US energy firms as exposed. Operational posture now targets commercial energy logistics of the adversary — one rung below strikes on US energy assets.

findings.headline: Brent nears $100 — six-week high as US-Iran war chokes Hormuz; Goldman bands $80-120
findings.source: Gulf News (Sep 8 00:35Z) / National Herald India / Economy Middle East (Goldman)
findings.summary: NEW RUNG: Brent pushed toward the $100 threshold (six-week high) as the war chokes Hormuz. Goldman frames $80-120 band conditional on regional export normalization. War band widens upward from $94-98 — direct stagflation feed into US/EU CPI prints due this fortnight.

findings.headline: LNG prices surge to multiyear highs; Europe depleted hydro reservoirs heading into winter — LNG crisis Europe 'cannot afford to ignore'
findings.summary: West Asia war squeezes LNG supplies to multiyear highs; Europe's hot dry summer evaporated hydro reservoirs and winter now hinges on securing marginal cargoes against Asia. Energy-inflation second wave stacking onto the ECB decision and euro sovereign stress.

findings.headline: Hormuz transit constraint sustained: tanker traffic lowest since May; Iran restricting Gulf shipping actively
findings.summary: Hormuz disruption persists at crisis levels (traffic lowest since May), with Iran now actively restricting Gulf shipping ahead of formal zone implementation. Sustained rung — no relief in shipping flows.

findings.headline: China injects $54bn (Y300bn+) into 8 state banks + insurers — bank/insurer shares SLIDE on 'limited short-term impact' amid weak credit demand
findings.source: BBC / Nikkei Asia / Caixin / SCMP / CNBC
findings.summary: Biggest state-bank recapitalization in two decades meets falling bank stocks: market reads it as confirmation of balance-sheet strain, not rescue. Insurers included (real-estate exposure backstop). Analysts say more needed; credit demand still weak. Escalated rung now market-confirmed.

findings.headline: OCC + FDIC finalize supervisory redefinition ('unsafe or unsound practices' -> material financial risks focus) amid bond wildfire
findings.source: Federal Register (Sep 1) / Consumer Finance Monitor / Crowell
findings.summary: US banking regulators finalized rules redefining supervisory terms and refocusing bank supervision on material financial risks — timing lands mid-selloff. Modest systemic signal; recorded as the period's principal US financial-regulatory change.

findings.headline: NEW: Fresh labor protests spread across Iran as Tehran DOUBLES third-tier gasoline price — war economy cracking at home
findings.summary: Long fuel queues and fresh demonstrations in Tehran, Ahvaz, Shush, Kermanshah, Dezful, Rasht after Tehran doubled third-tier gasoline prices; retired educators and telecom workers also out. Domestic pressure on the wartime government rising — unpredictable escalation vector for the war thread.

findings.headline: Jakarta protests EASE after lawmaker pay-hike reversal; aftermath lingers
findings.summary: DE-ESCALATION TICK: Indonesian protests eased after the pay-hike reversal, though analysts warn response inadequacy could reignite. Excluded from convergence tagging (signal direction is down); recorded for completeness.

findings.headline: DRC Ebola (Bundibugyo) sustained: 3,000+ deaths of 6,250 cases, outbreak 'still evolving', WHO adapting care in Bunia
findings.source: Reuters (Sep 2) / Health Policy Watch (Sep 3) / WHO AFRO (Sep 7)
findings.summary: Ebola deaths >3,000 of >6,250 confirmed cases; outbreak still evolving; WHO regional response adapting. Sustained — no new acceleration rung in window.

findings.headline: UST 10Y at the 4.8% test — sustained break 'could create meaningful spillover' into other assets; global selloff US 4.8 / UK 5.25 / JGB 3.0
findings.summary: 10-year Treasury hovers at the 4.8% threshold with fiscal-risk spillover warnings; UK gilts 5.25%, JGB 10Y ~3.0%. The bond wildfire's next leg is a single decisive break away.

findings.headline: S&P 500 slips below 7,700 as bond yields surge and stocks tumble on inflation fears
findings.summary: Equity tape deteriorating in sympathy with the bond selloff — risk-asset transmission channel active while CPI verdict pending.

findings.headline: NEW: Bitcoin below $79K — $208M long liquidation rout; sharpest deleveraging since 2023
findings.summary: BTC broke below $79K with a $208M longs rout; Binance futures OI dipped below 180-day average — sharpest deleveraging since 2023. Crypto stress increment while risk assets sell off globally.

findings.headline: NEW: $320M Liquid Network breach hits during record deleveraging — crypto infrastructure shock
findings.summary: A $320M breach of the Liquid Network (BTC sidechain/transfer plumbing) coincides with the deleveraging wave — infrastructure-layer stress, not just price. Single-source; MEDIUM confidence.

findings.headline: Peso record low sustained — oil shock erodes EM dollar reserves; JPM/BoA see 65/USD by mid-2027
findings.summary: Philippine peso left behind in Asia as the oil shock drains dollar reserves of import-heavy EMs; JPM/BoA target 65/USD by mid-2027. EM reserve-erosion channel sustained.

findings.headline: NEW: Gary Shilling — 60-70% recession probability within 12 months; consumer warnings flashing
findings.summary: Named high-profile recession call added to the chorus: consumer signals point to recession in 12 months at 60-70% odds. Opinion-layer but widens the recession-call camp during the stagflation band.

findings.headline: Japan bond rout turning tide of global capital — repatriation channel sustained
findings.summary: JGB repricing keeps pulling domestic capital home — the structural outflow channel from US/EU assets persists (carry-over sustained; no fresh increment in window).

findings.headline: France now borrows more expensively than Italy — OAT/BTP inversion mainstreamed; EU borrowing costs at/near multi-decade highs
findings.summary: France-Italy yield inversion confirmed and now surfaced in mainstream market commentary; eurozone sovereign borrowing costs at or near multi-decade highs amid inflation and fiscal-risk pressure. Euro-crisis knot remains live into the ECB decision.

convergence_detection.methodology: Sum of (imminence x impact) for all findings tagged with each thread across different categories. Thread score = min(100, round(raw_sum x 0.17) + 5x(categories_beyond_2)). Threshold: >=50 = DEVELOPING, >=100 = ACTIVE (capped). De-escalation-tick findings (su-002 Jakarta easing) carry no thread tags and are excluded from convergence. Hand-assessment layer (blackwatch-macro-event.json) applies confirmed-state-change rule on the 0-200 composite scale and remains the live board.
